sar.narrative:
**SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT NARRATIVE**
**Case Reference:** HHG-014  

This Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) is submitted by the Fraud and AML Compliance Department to detail suspicious account activity identified during an internal review under Case Reference HHG-014. The primary subject of this investigation is customer C13487, associated with payment card account C13487-K1. Between November 1, 2016, and December 31, 2016, the financial institution detected unauthorized digital access targeting the subject’s account through an online interface. The access was conducted using an unregistered device profile, bypassing standard customer device recognition protocols. Although zero unauthorized transactions successfully cleared during the monitoring period, internal systems flagged attempted unauthorized exposure totaling $100.00 USD. A comprehensive system-wide investigation identified no connected cards, secondary profiles, or co-conspirators involved in this activity. The observed access attempts exhibited an undocumented pattern that strays significantly from customer C13487’s historical interaction baseline. This activity is deemed suspicious as it reflects potential credential testing or attempted account takeover without any apparent lawful or economic purpose. Consequently, the institution has restricted card C13487-K1, initiated enhanced credential security protocols for customer C13487, and will maintain active surveillance on the account.
